## Analysis overview

Selects post-baseline threshold parameters, chooses each subject's maximum and latest qualifying record, summarizes baseline-to-analysis shifts by treatment, and calculates a Mantel–Haenszel p-value for transaminase shifts.

## ADaM datasets

- `ADLBHY`
- `ADSL`

## Key ADaM variables

- `PARAMCD`: threshold parameter code, including TRANSHY and HYLAW
- `BASE`: baseline threshold status
- `AVAL`: analysis threshold status
- `AVISITN`: analysis visit
- `USUBJID`: subject identifier
- `SAFFL`: safety flag
- `TRTP`: planned treatment.
